blind.description: An ornate pedestal supporting a glowing spherical orb or crystal ball. The pale lavender/violet sphere is cradled in a brass or bronze cupped socket with four curved prongs. Under the socket is a burgundy/maroon draped cloth with golden fringe trim, supported by a spiral-twisted column atop a molded circular stepped base. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous without floating fragments or mesh defects.
blind.from_above: A pale purple/lavender circle representing the top of the orb, flanked symmetrically by four small protruding bronze prongs against a circular base outline.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall) and about 1 ft in diameter at the base.

notes: sphere has a pale lavender tint rather than plain milky-white
